title: Puzzle 3d Selectable Hover Inspector
description: Make puzzle 3D objects, vortices, and attractions selectable and hoverable in the canvas; show full details in the inspector with editable fields.
summary: Extended SelectionSnapshot with attractionIds and unified commitPuzzle3dSelection for canvas picks. Objects click-select; vortices select on tap and drag past threshold to connect; attraction lines render in play, support hover/selected styling and click-select. Inspector shows editable vortex label/kind/position/direction/radius and attraction kind/endpoints. Fixed noteSelection to sync attractionIds from canvas.
